initialExam.title: Kerala PSC 2026
initialExam.description: Kerala PSC conducts examinations for recruitment to various state government posts including administrative, police, teaching, and technical positions in Kerala.
initialExam.eligibility: Varies by post - Graduate for administrative posts
initialExam.applicationFee: Nil (Kerala PSC does not charge application fees)
initialExam.syllabus: Varies by post. Administrative: GK, Current Affairs, Malayalam, English, Mental Ability, Constitution.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Interview (if applicable) → Ranked List → Appointment
initialExam.jobRole: Various Kerala state government posts across departments
initialExam.careerGrowth: Depends on post. Administrative: Deputy Collector → ADC → DC.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit keralapsc.gov.in 2. One-time registration 3. Apply for posts 4. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Pension, Festival allowance
